doc: Every crafting recipe: what it takes, what it makes and how long it takes.

ids.rule: The stable name starts as the recipe's debug name in lower case. A recipe without a debug name is game:recipe_<its 32-bit recipe id as 8 hex digits> (the name Kiln's content selectors already give it). Recipes and items are separate registries: a recipe may have the same id as the item it makes. When two recipes would get the same name, the one that held it first keeps it and the other is game:<name>~<first 8 hex digits of its GUID>.

inputs.doc: What one craft takes: an item or an input category, and a count.

item.doc: The item; absent when the input is a category.

category.doc: An input category (any item of it); absent when the input is an item.

count.doc: How many of the item or category one craft takes.
How many of the item one craft makes.

duration.doc: How long a station takes for one craft.

unlock.doc: When players see the recipe: game = the game's own knowledge requirement, always = from the start. Only the crafting menu reads it (a client without Kiln keeps the game's).

station.doc: The station the recipe belongs to: a stations id, none for a recipe of the player's own crafting. Read-only for game recipes: the game sorts recipes into stations once at start.

entry.removeDoc: GameStart only. Hides the recipe from station lists and the all-recipes/crafting view. Keeps the recipe record, id lookup and already-running crafts.
